sentence: No matter how bad my mood is, that perfect combination is always enough to lift my spirits.
translation: 不管我的心情有多糟糕，那种完美的组合总能振奋我的精神。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句：No matter how + 形容词 + 主谓——让步状语从句（= However bad my mood is）；注意语序：how 后紧跟形容词 bad，再接主谓 | 课堂辨析（高频陷阱）：whatever/whoever 等引导名词性从句（作句子成分）时不能换 no matter what/who——Whatever you say is right.（主语从句，不可替换）| be enough to do 足以做某事 | lift one's spirits 振奋精神（spirits 复数表情绪；类似 raise one's spirits）| 治愈系食物文章的开篇自白：先给“再糟也能治愈”的钩子
pattern: No matter how + adj. + S + is, S + is enough to + V
imitationCn: 不管压力有多大，操场上跑三圈总足以让我重新振作。
imitationHint: No matter how great the pressure is, → three laps around the playground are always enough to lift my spirits
imitationAnswer: No matter how great the pressure is, three laps around the playground are always enough to lift my spirits.

sentence: Sometimes the smell alone can do the trick, not to mention the lovely creamy flavour, which works like a time machine immediately transporting me back to my sunny childhood.
translation: 有时只闻到香味就能奏效，更不用说那美妙的奶油味了——它像一台时光机，立刻把我送回阳光灿烂的童年。
analysis: 课件结构分析句（三层）| the smell alone：alone 后置修饰“单是气味”| do the trick 奏效、达到目的（习语：A bit more sugar should do the trick.）| not to mention 更不用说（引出更强的论据，呼应必修二 U1 的 not to mention）| which 引导非限定性定语从句修饰 flavour，从句内 transporting... 现在分词短语作后置定语修饰 a time machine——从句套分词的双层修饰 | works like a time machine 明喻：气味-记忆的通感联结 | transport sb back to 把某人送回（时空动词的比喻用法）
pattern: S + alone can do the trick, not to mention + N, which + works like + N + V-ing ...
imitationCn: 有时光是那段旋律就足以奏效，更不用说完整的歌词了——它像一把钥匙，立刻打开我尘封多年的记忆。
imitationHint: Sometimes the melody alone can do the trick, not to mention the complete lyrics, → which work like a key immediately unlocking memories sealed for years
imitationAnswer: Sometimes the melody alone can do the trick, not to mention the complete lyrics, which work like a key immediately unlocking memories sealed for years.

sentence: With pleasure, I remember the lazy Sunday afternoons I used to spend in the warmth of my grandma's flat, listening to her wonderful stories and greedily eating bowl after bowl of her delicious rice pudding.
translation: 欣欣然，我想起从前在外婆温暖的公寓里度过的那些慵懒的周日午后——一边听她讲精彩的故事，一边一碗接一碗贪婪地吃着她做的美味大米布丁。
analysis: 课件结构分析+仿写题 | the lazy Sunday afternoons (which/that) I used to spend...：省略关系词的定语从句（关系词作 spend 的宾语）| listening... and greedily eating...：and 连接两个现在分词短语作伴随状语——逻辑主语是句子主语 I（课堂规则：逻辑主语不一致时须加自身主语变独立主格：..., his pet dog following him）| bowl after bowl of “一碗接一碗”（N after N 呼应必修三 U3 的 shop after shop）| used to do 过去常常 | in the warmth of 在……的温暖里（抽象名词具象化）| 回忆场景描写的满分范式：时间+地点+两条并行动作线
pattern: With pleasure, S + remember + the N + (that)定从, V-ing ... and adv. + V-ing + N after N of ...
imitationCn: 我珍视在大学度过的那四年时光——一边学习如何与他人合作，一边为踏入职场做好准备。
imitationHint: I greatly value the four years I spent in university, → learning how to work with others and getting prepared for starting my career（课堂仿写原题）
imitationAnswer: I greatly value the four years I spent in university, learning how to work with others and getting prepared for starting my career.

sentence: In this article, we will talk about a particular type of comfort food whose power mainly lies in the associations it calls to mind.
translation: 本文我们要谈一种特殊的治愈系食物，它的力量主要在于它所唤起的联想。
analysis: 双定语从句嵌套：whose power... 引导定语从句修饰 comfort food（whose 表所属“它的力量”）；从句内 the associations (that) it calls to mind 又是一层省略关系词的定语从句 | call sth to mind 唤起、使想起（= bring to mind；课堂拓展：association 联想/协会/交往，be associated with 与……相关联）| lie in 在于（呼应必修二 U4 的 lies more in）| a particular type of 某种特定的 | 说明文的“预告句”：先立定义域（哪一类）再立论点（力量何在）——总起段的标准动作
pattern: S + will talk about + N + whose + N + lies in + the N + (that) + S + calls to mind
imitationCn: 今天我们要聊一种特别的老物件，它的价值主要在于它所承载的时光记忆。
imitationHint: Today we will talk about a particular type of old object → whose value mainly lies in the memories it carries（whose + 嵌套定从）
imitationAnswer: Today we will talk about a particular type of old object whose value mainly lies in the memories it carries.

sentence: They vary from person to person, depending on our own unique experiences that have shaped our lives.
translation: 它们因人而异，取决于塑造了我们人生的独特经历。
analysis: vary from person to person 因人而异（课堂 vary 全网：vary from A to B / between A and B、vary with 随……而变、vary in 在……方面不同；various 各种各样的、a variety of）| depending on... 现在分词短语作状语“取决于”（= which depend on...，分词化后更轻盈）| that have shaped our lives：that 定语从句 + 现在完成时——经历“已经塑造”且影响延续 | shape 动词“塑造”（熟词活用）| 因果句式的组合拳：vary（现象）+ depending on（机制）+ shaped（根源），三步递进到底
pattern: S + vary from person to person, depending on + N + that have + V-ed ...
imitationCn: 学习方法因人而异，取决于塑造了我们思维习惯的成长环境。
imitationHint: Learning methods vary from person to person, → depending on the growing environments that have shaped our thinking habits
imitationAnswer: Learning methods vary from person to person, depending on the growing environments that have shaped our thinking habits.

sentence: According to some food experts, there are some aspects of culture that people will lose right away, but with food, there are more opportunities to connect to memory, family and place.
translation: 据一些食物专家所言，文化中的某些方面人们很快就会失去，但借助食物，就有更多机会与记忆、家庭和故土保持连接。
analysis: 课件结构分析句 | 双 there be 对照：there are some aspects... that people will lose（that 定语从句，that 作 lose 的宾语）vs there are more opportunities to connect...（不定式短语作后置定语）——“会失去的”与“能留住的”打对台 | but with food 转折+条件：with 短语轻巧扛起“凭借食物”| connect to memory, family and place：三名词并列由虚到实（记忆→家人→故土）| According to 援引专家开路——观点的可信度包装 | 文化传承类作文的核心论证句
pattern: According to ..., there are + N + that ..., but with + N, there are more opportunities to + V + A, B and C
imitationCn: 据一些学者所言，方言中的某些表达正在迅速消失，但借助民谣，就有更多机会与乡音、故事和祖辈相连。
imitationHint: According to some scholars, there are some expressions in dialects that are disappearing fast, → but with folk songs, there are more opportunities to connect to local sounds, stories and ancestors
imitationAnswer: According to some scholars, there are some expressions in dialects that are disappearing fast, but with folk songs, there are more opportunities to connect to local sounds, stories and ancestors.

sentence: One mouthful of comfort food takes us back to our cultural roots, giving us the 'taste of home' that we cry out for and relieving feelings of homesickness.
translation: 一口治愈系食物就能把我们带回文化之根，带来我们渴求的“家的味道”，一解思乡之情。
analysis: One mouthful of... 作主语：“一口”的以小博大（物作主语 + 数量词开头的冲击力）| takes us back to 把我们带回（时空动词再现，呼应 time machine）| 两个现在分词 giving... and relieving... 作结果状语——主句动作引出的双重效果 | the 'taste of home' that we cry out for：that 定语从句 + cry out for 迫切渴求（介词 for 悬空句尾）| relieve feelings of homesickness 缓解乡愁（relieve stress/pain；to one's relief）| 文章点题句：一口吃食连着文化根脉——中国胃的学术表达
pattern: One mouthful of + N + takes us back to ..., V-ing ... that we cry out for and V-ing ...
imitationCn: 一段熟悉的乡音就能把我们带回童年的巷口，带来我们念念不忘的烟火气，抚平漂泊的疲惫。
imitationHint: One phrase of familiar dialect takes us back to the childhood lanes, → giving us the everyday warmth that we long for and easing the tiredness of drifting（双分词）
imitationAnswer: One phrase of familiar dialect takes us back to the childhood lanes, giving us the everyday warmth that we long for and easing the tiredness of drifting.

sentence: Sichuan hot pots are perfect for the damp, foggy climate in which they were invented.
translation: 四川火锅完美契合其发源地潮湿多雾的气候。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句：in which 引导定语从句（= where），先行词 climate 是抽象“环境”——课堂同族：I've reached the stage where/in which I just don't care. / cases where/in which pressure can be turned into motivation | they were invented 从句用被动（火锅“被发明”）| damp, foggy 双形容词并列修饰（逗号连接不用 and）| be perfect for 完美适配 | 一句话讲透“一方水土一方味”：气候→饮食的因果论证，美食文化说明文的样板句
pattern: S + are perfect for + the adj., adj. + N + in which + S + were + V-ed
imitationCn: 凉茶完美契合其诞生地湿热漫长的夏季。
imitationHint: Herbal tea is perfect for the hot, humid summers → in which it was created（in which 定从+被动）
imitationAnswer: Herbal tea is perfect for the hot, humid summers in which it was created.

sentence: Served plain in thin, white slices, the meat is juicy and salty.
translation: 那肉切成薄薄的白片、原味上桌，多汁而咸香。
analysis: Served plain... 过去分词短语开头作状语——逻辑主语是句子主语 the meat（肉“被端上来”，被动关系用过去分词）| plain 副词性用法“原味地、不加修饰地”（plain 课堂多义：朴素的/清楚的/平原）| in thin, white slices 切成薄白片（slice 切片：slice sth in two、a slice of）| juicy and salty 双形容词收尾——口感的直给 | 九词写活一道盐水鸭：分词状语+介词短语+双形容词的“素描三件套”，美食描写以简驭繁的典范
pattern: V-ed + adv. + in + adj., adj. + N, S + is + adj. and adj.
imitationCn: 热腾腾地盛在粗瓷碗里，那碗面筋道而鲜香。
imitationHint: Served hot in a rough china bowl, → the noodles are chewy and savoury（过去分词开头）
imitationAnswer: Served hot in a rough china bowl, the noodles are chewy and savoury.

sentence: As I finished my first helping on a recent afternoon in Nanjing, my host, Chef Zhang, told me a little more about the dish.
translation: 最近一个下午在南京，我刚吃完第一份，东道主张厨师就跟我多聊了几句这道菜。
analysis: 课件 as 专项讲解句：as 引导时间状语从句“正当……的时候”（谓语为非持续动词 finished 时可换 when）——课堂 as 五用总表：时间/原因（As you were out...）/让步倒装（Happy as they were...）/方式（Do as I say!）/比较（not as hard as I thought）| helping 熟词僻义：食物的“一份、一客”（my first helping 我的第一份）——不是“帮助”！| my host, Chef Zhang 同位语 | a little more about 委婉的“再多讲了些” | 美食游记的叙事标配：时间地点+人物+引出下文故事
pattern: As + S + finished + N + 时间地点, my host, 同位语, told me a little more about ...
imitationCn: 我刚尝完第二份小笼包，店主李师傅就跟我讲起了这门手艺的来历。
imitationHint: As I finished my second helping of soup dumplings, → the owner, Master Li, told me about the origin of the craft（helping = 一份食物）
imitationAnswer: As I finished my second helping of soup dumplings, the owner, Master Li, told me about the origin of the craft.

sentence: In the last few weeks, I've thrown myself into home cooking, from boiling noodles in the pot to frying steak in the pan.
translation: 过去几周里，我全身心投入居家烹饪——从锅里煮面到平底锅煎牛排。
analysis: throw oneself into 全身心投入（反身代词 + into；课堂例句：Since her husband died, she's thrown herself into her work.）| In the last few weeks + 现在完成时 I've thrown：时间段信号词 | from boiling... to frying...：from... to... 接双动名词对举，画出投入的广度；in the pot / in the pan 两个炊具各归各位——细节的对称美 | 生活转变的自述句：疫情/假期宅家类作文的常用素材 | 呼应“治愈系食物”主题：吃是治愈，做也是治愈
pattern: In the last few weeks, S + have thrown myself into + N, from + V-ing ... to + V-ing ...
imitationCn: 这个学期以来，我全身心投入社团活动——从筹备晨会到主持辩论赛。
imitationHint: Since this term began, I've thrown myself into club activities, → from preparing morning meetings to hosting debate contests（from doing to doing）
imitationAnswer: Since this term began, I've thrown myself into club activities, from preparing morning meetings to hosting debate contests.

sentence: To eat out was also a social activity, allowing me to enhance the relationship with my friends.
translation: 外出就餐也是一种社交活动，让我得以增进和朋友们的关系。
analysis: To eat out 不定式短语作主语（= Eating out，用不定式更显“一件事”的整体感）——不定式/动名词主语的语体差异 | allowing me to... 现在分词短语作结果状语（= which allowed me to...）：主句陈述属性、分词补充效果 | enhance 提升、增进（课堂搭配：enhance the flavour/efficiency/public image/friendship——写作里替换 improve 的高级词）| eat out 外出就餐（out 副词）| 议论文分论点句式：X was also a..., allowing sb to...——一句话立论+论证
pattern: To + V + was also a + N, allowing + sb + to enhance + N
imitationCn: 晨跑也是一种社交活动，让我得以结识志同道合的邻居。
imitationHint: To run in the morning was also a social activity, → allowing me to get to know like-minded neighbours（不定式主语+分词结果状语）
imitationAnswer: To run in the morning was also a social activity, allowing me to get to know like-minded neighbours.
